title: Analysis code for predicting next-wave high-risk smartphone overdependence in Korean adolescents (KCYPS 2018)

creators.name: Song, Dahyun

description: Analysis code and aggregate results for a longitudinal prediction study using the Korean Children and Youth Panel Survey 2018. Predictors measured at grade t estimate high-risk Smartphone Addiction Proneness Scale classification at grade t+1 across the Grade 7 to Grade 10 transitions. Individual-level records derived from KCYPS 2018 are not distributed.
